\paragraph{Equation branch\_profiles (revision 2)}
Use each retained n/l energy difference consistently in the branch profile, thermal Doppler width, extinction and emissivity prefactors. Sum branch coefficients before forming the source. Full radiative lifetimes are unchanged.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
\widetilde\nu_{ul}=(E_u-E_l)/(hc),\quad \Delta\widetilde\nu_{ul}=\widetilde\nu-\widetilde\nu_{ul}+\widetilde\nu_{ul}v_{\rm los}/c,\\L_i=\sum_{j<i}A_{ij}+\delta_{i,2s}A_{2\gamma},\quad \gamma_{ul}=(L_u+L_l)/(4\pi c),\quad \int\phi_{ul}(\widetilde\nu)\,d\widetilde\nu=1,\\\alpha_{\widetilde\nu}=\sum_{ul}\frac{A_{ul}}{8\pi c\widetilde\nu_{ul}^2}\left(\frac{g_u}{g_l}n_l-n_u\right)\phi_{ul},\quad j_{\widetilde\nu}=\sum_{ul}\frac{hc\widetilde\nu_{ul}A_{ul}}{4\pi}n_u\phi_{ul}
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:escape.nlte_5f_spectrum:branch_5f_profiles:2}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Scope:} Current three n/l H-alpha branches: 3s-to-2p, 3p-to-2s and 3d-to-2p. The NIST scalar center still defines the observer grid and reported velocity origin. This does not resolve full fine-J structure or establish absolute centroid accuracy.

\item[$\gamma_{ul}$] Natural Lorentz half width (cm\textasciicircum{}-1; ID: gamma).

\item[$n_i$] Actual resolved state population (cm\textasciicircum{}-3; ID: bound).
\item[$E_i$] Retained n/l level energy (erg; ID: level\_energy).
